_note: MCP tool catalog for verify-gaode-ban-contract.sh (T3). Lists every MCP tool name that takes a string-valued URL/path/code/filename argument. Used to enforce gaode-policy contract coverage drift detection: when a new MCP server is added, this catalog file diff alerts the maintainer to add the new tool to the integration-test set. Cycle-3 BA REVISION-2 mandates inclusion of all 6 architect-listed MCP vectors plus 3 catalog-completeness output-save filename fields per Codex Q2. M5 (policy_version=2, 2026-05-14) adds substring/segment/user-global/parent-scan match-kinds so the contract verifier exercises every new matcher introduced by the cycle-3 bypass closure.
_schema: Each entry: {tool, field, surface, expected_match_kind}. surface = read-path | network-host | env-var. expected_match_kind = direct | url-substring | list-item | gmail-body | wildcard-prefix | user-global-root | ramdisk-symlink | parent-scan-glob | parent-scan-grep | segment-token | substring-underscore.
